steps.footnote: A section is Ready when this project holds every kind of data it needs, Partial when it holds some, and Missing inputs when it holds none. What is counted: the project’s recorded nonclinical and clinical studies, its adverse events and risk management plan, and its Module 3 sections. Documents filed in the project’s Vault are not counted. AnA drafts the open sections from the linked summaries and never invents results. One study register in this workspace does not record which project a study belongs to, so it is not counted here.
